review_evidence: README identifies CvxLean as a Lean convex-optimization modeling framework with formal optimization objects, equivalence/reduction/relaxation relations, and a proof-producing disciplined-convex-programming transformation.

The current-primary tree includes the formal library, syntax/tactic/meta implementation, demos, and tests; an inspected DCP test module defines many concrete optimization problems as formal Solution objects and invokes the proof-producing transformation, including unfinished proof obligations that remain useful prior-art statements.
Demos/tests are therefore formal examples and theorem-bearing regression material, not disposable scaffolding under FILTER-009/FILTER-011; no safe hard exclusion was established.
summary: Retain CvxLean's full formal library, transformations, demos, and test problems because they encode optimization definitions and proof obligations.
